capabilities: , Visualize family trees as SVG diagrams
Export trees to HTML and GEDCOM
Create person notes via modal command
Navigate and re-root the tree view
disambiguation: It is not designed to be a canonically correct genealogical tool; it is optimized for practical, everyday use.
motivation: Arbor grew out of a personal project to easily visualise my own family history.
problem: Managing and visualizing complex family history stored across multiple notes in a structured way.
summary: A plugin for building, visualizing, and exporting family trees stored as Markdown notes within the vault.
